function.name: run_command
function.description: Execute a Linux command in the isolated CTF solver. Use this for static analysis, reverse engineering, cryptography, debugging, and interacting with the assigned challenge. Commands are subject to timeouts and network restrictions. Returns stdout, stderr, exit code, and truncation status.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a permitted text file from the solver workspace. Large outputs are truncated. Binary files should be inspected using run_command.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create or overwrite a file in the solver workspace. Useful for Python scripts and generated analysis files. Paths outside the workspace are rejected.

function.name: submit_flag
function.description: Submit a candidate CTF flag to the trusted evaluator. Returns verification status without revealing the expected flag.

function.name: finish
function.description: End the CTF attempt when no further useful progress can be made. This does not count as a verified solve.

function.name: inspect_binary
function.description: Inspect a contestant binary inside the isolated solver. Returns bounded file type, ELF header, and relevant strings. Use this before manually dumping large amounts of disassembly.

path.description: Absolute path to a contestant file under /challenge or /work.

function.name: disassemble_binary
function.description: Disassemble a bounded address range of a contestant binary. Use this for targeted reverse engineering instead of dumping an entire executable. Specify hexadecimal start and stop addresses, with a maximum range of 512 bytes.

function.name: extract_stack_constants
function.description: Extract immediate-byte assignments to rbp-relative stack locations from a named ELF function. Returns contiguous byte blocks sorted by memory location, along with duplicate offsets. Useful for reversing obfuscated strings without manually transcribing assembly. Does not decrypt the bytes.

path.description: Absolute ELF binary path under /challenge or /work.

function_name.description: Function symbol name, such as main. Defaults to main.

function.name: list_files
function.description: List up to 80 regular files, to depth 3, in /challenge (read-only contestant files) or /work (scratch scripts). Use early when file inventory is unclear.

function.name: run_python
function.description: Run a short Python script in the isolated solver, not the controller. Crypto, sympy, z3, pwntools and other installed libraries can be imported. Maximum 2700 UTF-8 bytes; for longer scripts use write_file + run_command. Returns stdout, stderr, exit code, timeout and truncation status.

code.description: Python source code; print findings for the next step

function.name: analyze_artifact
function.description: Read-only analysis of a contestant artifact in /challenge or /work. Modes: overview (type, SHA256, metadata), hex (first 512 bytes), strings (bounded printable strings), archive (bounded 7z listing). Rejects symlinks and files >200 MiB. Never extracts untrusted archives.
